status_summary: H.R. 7085, introduced by Rep. Huizenga on 2026-01-15 and referred to the Financial Services Committee, would repeal only the conflict minerals disclosure requirement (Exchange Act section 13(p) and Dodd-Frank section 1502); it does not touch mine safety, resource extraction or pay ratio. The House Financial Services Committee ordered it reported on 2026-01-22, and the Congressional Budget Office published its estimate on 2026-02-27. No floor action was found. Separately, an SEC proposal of 2026-05-21 on emerging growth company accommodations and filer status would extend scaled-disclosure accommodations that include pay ratio and resource extraction relief to non-accelerated filers, but it is a proposal and not a repeal.

timeline.event: H.R. 7085 was introduced to repeal the Exchange Act conflict minerals disclosure requirement and Dodd-Frank section 1502, and referred to the House Financial Services Committee.
The House Financial Services Committee ordered H.R. 7085 reported.
The SEC published a proposal (91 FR 30086) to extend smaller reporting company and emerging growth company disclosure accommodations to non-accelerated filers; the comment period ended 2026-07-20.
